title: Asahina Mafuyu — Looking Up At The Same Moon〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Looking Up At The Same Moon（2★）

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That should be it for morning practice today...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I hope practice wasn't too hard for you today. Do you feel all right? Are you tired at all?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I feel fine. I appreciate your concern, but I actually thought practice today was quite fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you like to walk with me? I know we're in different classes, but maybe just part way?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Unless you're in a hurry...
I was hoping to chat a little since we've never really had a chance to...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I'd be happy to.
Thank you for the offer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina...
Would you mind hearing this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You know how you gave me some suggestions for my group's stream the other day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thanks to you, we were able to come up with some wonderful ideas!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, so am I!
We were able to have a nice moon viewing party as a result.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We made some dango together and even did a segment where we pretended to be rabbits.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Again, it's all thanks to you.
I'm so glad I asked you for help, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm still not sure if I really did much, but I'm glad that I was able to help, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, does your family do moon viewings?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hmm... Not lately, and I doubt we'll be doing one this year.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But you said, Lately.
Does that mean you used to do them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I was little, around the time I was in kindergarten or elementary school, I used to participate in moon viewings, Christmas parties and such...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I also participated in my kindergarten's moon viewing parties and got to make dango with my classmates.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's all still very fresh in my mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's time for class already...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wish we could chat a little more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure we'll have plenty of chances. After all, we go to the same school and are in the same club.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, Asahina, thank you for your time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, let's.
And thank you too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll see you again during practice.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But my schedule today really only involves studying and working on Nightcord.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It hardly feels like a tradition to me at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I need to get to class...
